course_name_original: UE4 Culture générale et outils de calcul
course_name_en: UE4 General Culture and Calculation Tools
prerequisites: Vectors, positioning and coordinates in the plane and space
Cartesian equations of lines and planes

learning_outcomes.text: Enable students to master the digital skills necessary to continue their higher education curriculum or their socio-professional path.
Prepare students for passing the PIX digital skills certification test.
Use standard digital tools and IT security rules to acquire, process, produce and disseminate information, as well as to collaborate internally and externally.
Provide fundamental complements in mathematical reasoning and proofs.

Provide a rigorous framework for the manipulation and positioning of vectors in any dimension, with particular attention to methods for solving linear systems, calculating coordinates in different bases, and calculating Cartesian equations of lines, planes, and other vector subspaces.
Reason and demonstrate, write a proof.
Solve a linear system of equations.
Be able to calculate vector coordinates in different bases.
Understand the concept of vector subspaces and dimension.
Mobilize mathematical concepts to approach and solve problems with a high level of abstraction.
Implement methods and tools from the disciplinary field.
Identify a questioning within a disciplinary field.
Analyze a questioning by mobilizing disciplinary concepts.

syllabus_topics: Elements of logic: propositions, logical operators, proof methods.
Sets and applications: definitions and operations on sets, cardinality, generalities on applications, bijectivity, direct and inverse images of subsets.
Linear systems: definitions, existence and uniqueness of solution, Gaussian elimination algorithm.
Vectors in Rn: operations, linearly independent and spanning sets, bases, change of coordinates.
Vector subspaces of Rn: definitions, bases and dimension.

assessment_methods.method: Continuous Assessment (Outils d'algèbre pour les sciences element)
